inputs.original_text: Nigeria’s democracy is facing a transformation that is both alarming and largely underexamined, as political parties—once intended to be platforms for representation and public service—are increasingly becoming exclusive clubs for the wealthy. The latest developments within the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections make this trend painfully clear.
